verdict.rationale: Capacities ships a built-in AI assistant. Its docs say it answers from your notes, plans multi-step work, and proposes creates and updates for you to approve. Related built-in features cover delegable tasks: AI chats with blocks or notes as context, property auto-fill, and image analysis/OCR. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works, and detail on how far multi-step plans execute beyond proposals that need approval.
